data.gender_notes: Hadiyyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A gift or reward given to someone, often as a sign of appreciation or gratitude. The name Hadiyyah carries the meaning “Gift” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Hadiyyah usually hope their child will grow to embody gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of Allah's blessings and generosity towards us.
data.etymology: Hadiyyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hadiyyah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_english.name: Hadiyyah
in_english.long_meaning: Hadiyyah is a name that signifies a gift from Allah, emphasizing gratitude and appreciation for the blessings bestowed upon humanity, derived from the Arabic root hdi, meaning closeness and nearness to God, carrying deep spiritual significance in Islamic tradition

data.cultural_impact: In Islamic culture, the giving and receiving of Hadiyya (plural for Hadiyyah) holds significant importance. It is an essential act of courtesy and hospitality, and is highly valued in building and strengthening relationships. Hadiyyah can take various forms, from simple gifts like fruits or sweets, to more substantial presents like valuable possessions or even land. In many cases, Hadiyyah is given as a token of goodwill during occasions such as weddings, births, or the completion of a journey or a religious pilgrimage (known as Hajj). Giving and receiving Hadiyyah signifies generosity, kindness, and respect towards others, and is a cherished custom that fosters bonds between individuals and communities.
data.spiritual_significance: Hadiyyah also carries deep spiritual significance, as it is reminiscent of the blessings and rewards that Allah (God) bestows upon His creation. By giving and receiving gifts, Muslims are reminded of the simplicity and joy found in acts of kindness and selflessness. It also serves as a reflection of the prophetic tradition in which Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) would often give gifts to his Companions, inviting them to come closer to Allah and strengthen their faith through acts of generosity and love. Thus, Hadiyyah is an embodiment of the teachings of compassion, gratitude, and selflessness, offering a valuable reminder of the spiritual connection between giving, receiving, and the Creator.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Hadiyyah means a gift or present, symbolizing the spirit of generosity and selflessness in giving. It also represents the joy and happiness derived from giving and pleasing Allah and His creation.

It now represents the spirit of generosity, kindness, and goodwill towards others. On social media platforms, users share their Hadiyyah experiences using hashtags like #Hadiyyah or #EidGifts. E-commerce marketplaces have capitalized on this trend by offering a wide range of online Hadiyyah shopping options.
